titulo.estudio: Læsning 1 · Fortæller og perspektiv i prosa
titulo.alumno: A memory · Narrator and perspective in prose

intro: Part 1: a memory. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

texto: In prose, separate who narrates from who perceives. A scene may leave out explanations and let the reader infer a motive from gestures, references and changes of tense.
Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.
